findings.text: Loop modifies ExpectedCalls slice while iterating with index i; removing an element at i shifts subsequent elements down but i still increments, skipping the next element. Failing input: three ExpectedCalls to the same method—Unset() removes the first, skips the second, and only checks the third.

0.reason: The finding describes the exact same root cause: iterating with index i while removing elements via append(slice[:i], slice[i+1:]...) causes skipped elements and potential out-of-range panics.
